computers.tailnet.status.applies: applies to computers that start or thaw after the change; one already running keeps what it has until computers.stop, and turning it off never logs a running node out early
computers.tailnet.status.problem: the computer image does not carry the tailnet side yet, so no computer joins the tailnet even with this on

computers.egress.status.applies: applies to computers started after the change: a stopped computer is made again with it on its next start (its home stays); a running or frozen one keeps its old setting until computers.stop

sidecar.why: the Mac is asleep or away
